annotations.title: Ask a verified business a question

description: Ask one plain question about a verified business, for example "do you take emergency calls on weekends?" or "is the Tuesday class for beginners?". The answer is written at once from what the business published on Orbylon (who it is, its hours, its phone, what it sells and its prices) and from nothing else: when that does not answer the question, the reply says so (answered: false) and gives the business's phone to ask directly. It never guesses. Not every business answers questions here; one that does not points to list_business_offerings and lookup_business instead. Prices, bookings and orders still go through list_business_offerings, place_order and request_quote.
